title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-14 21:02:23 最新章节：第342章 巢穴
slug: 精灵族的修仙者第342章巢穴
content_zh:
银月森林。
高耸的橡树静默伫立，枝桠向四方伸展，冠盖层叠如云，将天光滤成无数细碎的光斑，落在覆满落叶的地面上。
罗曼靠坐在树荫下，半眯着琥珀色的眼眸，百无聊赖地摩挲着手里的斧头。
碎金般的阳光穿透叶隙，在她尖细的耳廓边缘流转，近乎透明，银白长发如瀑铺散而落，衬得肤色莹润如玉。
假如不考虑那柄寒光熠熠的斧头，无疑是一幅极美的画面。
这时，上方茂密的树冠里忽然传来一阵惊喜的声音。
“哈哈，道爷我成了！”
树冠剧烈晃动，落叶纷扬，惊起几只栖息的羽雀。
罗曼抬眸瞥了一眼，撇撇嘴，收回视线继续把玩斧头。
自从过了13岁的生日后，安东就变得古里古怪的，总是嘟囔一些让人听不懂的话。
什么‘一粒金丹吞入腹，始知我命不由天’、‘手握日月摘星辰，世间无我这般人’......
罗曼每个字都认识，但连起来就完全不懂了。
而且安东平日里也不像其他精灵一样喜欢种植花草，绘画编织，反而总是一个人跑到树冠上，摆出盘腿而坐的怪姿势，一坐就是好几个小时，也不知道有什么乐趣。
一开始的时候，罗曼还担心自己这个青梅竹马是不是哪里出了问题。
可观察一段时间下来，发现安东始终活蹦乱跳的，她也就放下心来，任由他去了。
哗啦！
一道身影从浓枝间跃下。
安东轻巧地落在罗曼身侧的树根上，半蹲卸力，扬起几片碎叶。
他同样生着尖耳，淡金色的长发用一根藤蔓随意束起，几缕碎发垂落在额前，衬得轮廓如神匠刀削般深邃。
眉骨微高，鼻梁挺直如剑脊，薄唇天然带笑，哪怕在都是俊男美女的精灵族中，这副样貌也称得上亮眼。

“罗曼，回去了。”
安东拍了拍身上沾着的树皮碎屑，朝罗曼微微一笑，日光恰好落在他侧脸上，让罗曼看得微微一怔。
不知道是不是错觉，明明只隔了几个小时，她却感觉安东身上似乎发生了某种变化，隐隐多了几分飘渺气质。
一对眼眸也变得更加明亮深邃，让她都有些不敢对视了。
少女连忙从地上起身，遮掩似的问道：“你刚才在上面叫喊什么？”
“没什么。”
安东嘴上否认，眼底却浮现出发自内心的欣喜。
五年了！
足足五年，总算炼出第一口灵气了！
回想起这五年日夜不辍的吐纳，安东就有种泪目的冲动。
他其实是个穿越者。
或者用转生来形容更加恰当。
某天正在大学宿舍里打着游戏，结果眼前一黑，醒来就成了一个刚刚出生的精灵族婴儿，就这么浑浑噩噩地度过了13年。
直到13岁生日的那个傍晚，大雨瓢泼，电闪雷鸣，安东站在窗边，看着一道紫电撕裂天穹，如龙蛇般碾过云层，陡然间心生顿悟。
对了，我上辈子是个人来着。
今日方知我是我。
记忆如潮水回涌，他终于想起自己穿越到了哪里。
《晨曦纪年录》！
一款全球流行的大型网游。
也是他穿越前正在玩的游戏。

而他则成了晨曦大陆东部银月森林里精灵族的一员。
说实话，一开始知道这点的时候，安东是有些崩溃的。
content_en:
Silver Moon Forest.
The towering oak tree stood silently, its branches stretched out in all directions, and its canopy was stacked like clouds, filtering the skylight into countless tiny spots of light that fell on the ground covered with fallen leaves.
Roman sat back in the shade of the tree, half-squinting his amber eyes, and caressing the ax in his hand boredly.
The sunlight like broken gold penetrated the gaps in the leaves and flowed around the edges of her pointed ears, almost transparent. Her long silver-white hair spread like a waterfall, making her skin as smooth as jade.
If you don't take into account the ax that shines with cold light, it is undoubtedly a very beautiful picture.
At this time, a sound of surprise suddenly came from the dense canopy of trees above.
"Haha, I've become a Taoist master!"
The crown of the tree shook violently, and the fallen leaves flew up, startling a few perching birds.
Roman glanced up, curled his lips, looked away and continued to play with the axe.
Since his 13th birthday, Anton has become eccentric, always muttering something incomprehensible.
What about ‘when I swallow a golden elixir, I realize that my fate is not determined by fate’, ‘holding the sun and moon in my hand to pick the stars, there is no one like me in the world’…
Roman knew every word, but he couldn't understand the words together.
Moreover, Anton does not like planting flowers, painting and weaving like other elves on weekdays. Instead, he always runs to the canopy of the tree alone and sits in a strange cross-legged posture. He sits there for several hours without knowing what fun it is.
At the beginning, Roman was worried that something was wrong with his childhood sweetheart.
But after observing for a period of time, she found that Anton was always alive and kicking, so she relaxed and let him go.
Wow!
A figure jumped down from the thick branches.
Anton landed lightly on the root of the tree beside Roman, half-crouched to release his strength, and raised a few broken leaves.
He also has pointed ears, and his long pale golden hair is tied up randomly with a vine. A few strands of broken hair hang down in front of his forehead, making his outline as deep as a craftsman's knife.
The eyebrows are slightly high, the bridge of the nose is as straight as the ridge of a sword, and the thin lips naturally smile. Even among the elves who are all handsome men and beautiful women, this appearance is still eye-catching.
"Roman, go back."
Anton patted the bark chips on his body and smiled at Roman. The sunlight happened to fall on the side of his face, making Roman look slightly startled.
She didn't know if it was an illusion, but even though it was only a few hours apart, she felt that something had changed in Anton, and he had a slightly more ethereal temperament.
A pair of eyes also became brighter and deeper, making her afraid to look at each other.
The girl quickly got up from the ground and asked as if to cover herself up: "What did you yell up there just now?"
"Nothing."
Anton denied it, but his eyes showed joy from the bottom of his heart.
Five years!
After five years, I finally refined my first breath of spiritual energy!
Recalling the five years of talking day and night, Anton felt the urge to burst into tears.
He is actually a time traveler.
Or reincarnation is a more appropriate description.
One day, I was playing games in my university dormitory. Suddenly my vision went dark and I woke up as a newborn Elf baby. I spent 13 years in such a state of confusion.
Until the evening of his 13th birthday, with heavy rain and lightning and thunder, Anton stood by the window and watched a streak of purple lightning tear through the sky and run through the clouds like a dragon and snake, and he suddenly had an epiphany.
By the way, I was alone in my last life.
Today I know who I am.
Memories came back like a tide, and he finally remembered where he had traveled through time.
"Morning Chronicle"!
A globally popular large-scale online game.
It was also the game he was playing before traveling through time.
And he became a member of the elves in the Silver Moon Forest in the eastern part of the Dawn Continent.
To be honest, Anton was a little broken when he first learned about this.
